title: AARON AND HUR HELD HIS HANDS

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"When Moses' hands grew tired, they took a stone and put it under him and he sat
on it. Aaron and Hur held his hands up-one on one side, one on the other-so that
his hands remained steady till sunset." - Ex 17:12 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This may be my favourite verse in the chapter.

Moses' hands grew tired. Of course they did. He was around eighty years old and
holding his arms above his head through an entire day of battle. Anyone would
have failed.

Notice that the text says it plainly. It does not hide his weakness or apologise
for it. The man who confronted Pharaoh and split a sea could not hold his own
arms up.

So they gave him a stone to sit on, and two men stood either side and held him.

Here is the point. The solution to Moses' weakness was not more determination.
It was other people. God's answer to his exhaustion was Aaron and Hur.

Many of us treat needing help as a failure. We would rather struggle privately
than admit our arms are shaking. But Scripture says, "Carry each other's burdens,
and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ" (Gal 6:2). Someone must be
carried for that command to be obeyed.

Notice one more thing: his hands remained steady till sunset. Not because Moses
became stronger, but because he was held.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Who are your Aaron and Hur, and do they know they are?
2. Whose arms could you hold up this week?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, thank You that You do not expect me to hold myself up. Show me who to
lean on and who needs me beside them. Amen.
